status: frozen before full candidate counts; exploratory feasibility, not confirmation
motivation: Three individually inspected CISI field and Mackay-row associations agree with literal field_no+no. Suffix meanings vary outside these examples. Existing zero strict-field-overlap result remains unchanged.
rule: Uppercase and remove whitespace only. Candidate table key is normalize(field_no)+normalize(no), compared literally to normalize(Lipi excavation-idno). Preserve punctuation, prefixes, leading zeroes and letters. No splits, repairs or other variants.
artifact_key: nonmissing CISI else lipi_id:+id before first dot; missing id gives no key
rejections: nonunique concatenated table key, including different-boundary collisions
table field key repeated under multiple rows
Lipi key shared by multiple artifact keys or missing artifact key
artifact under inconsistent nonmissing field keys
artifact under inconsistent sites or site not exact Mohenjo-daro
unit: provisional artifact locator; repeated rows retained as witnesses, not objects; no physical independence established
coverage: Complete exact raw tuple (area,block,house,room,level_ft) only when every component nonmissing and level finite numeric. Retain signed raw level string and area. Never use phase_estimate or shifted level_dk_ft. Tuple equality is a coverage diagnostic, not deposit identity or temporal equality.
stop: One source-order deterministic pass and complete candidate/exclusion ledger. No primary follow-up auto-launched or significance test. No parameter variants.
next_gate: Before contextual use, each artifact needs explicit primary CISI-field-Mackay chain, primary context/datum/stratigraphy verification, and physical-artifact plus independent-deposit audit. Freeze a separately bounded pilot first.
